packageRules.description: Do NOT digest-pin devcontainer features. Renovate's devcontainer manager + pinDigests appends a digest to the already-tagged feature ref, producing the INVALID combined form `ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/sshd:1@sha256:...` which @devcontainers/cli rejects (path-regex validation fails), breaking `devcontainer upgrade`/`up` and the lock-coverage test. Observed 2026-07-08 (PR #187 broke main; fixed here). Features stay tag-pinned; the base image digest is managed by the custom ubuntu manager below.

graphify: review-before-merge, never auto-merge. It ships ~2x/day as PATCH releases, so the blanket minor/patch automerge above would merge it unread twice a day. It is pre-1.0 with a documented history of SILENT data loss - v0.9.22 alone fixed a node whose source_file uses a URL scheme being evicted on the second update, and a real source dir named env/.env/*_env being pruned as a false-positive virtualenv 'with no trace in any output bucket'. That is exactly the class where a green build hides a corrupted graph, which no CI check can see - so `automerge: false` stays, and the 2-doc determinism probe gates the merge. NO minimumReleaseAge (removed 2026-07-20, Ray's call): a soak delay does not add safety on top of automerge:false - it only delays the PR while we keep running the KNOWN-buggy version we are already on. The prior 3-day hold was an agent's prescription, not a measured requirement, and it deviated from this repo's global `minimumReleaseAge: null`. Renovate now opens the PR the moment a release lands; a human still reads the notes before merging.

#288 `apt-ubuntu-pockets`: give every [bootstrap.packages] deb dep ALL FOUR upstreams and let the deb datasource's registryStrategy='merge' (lib/modules/datasource/deb/index.ts) route each by where it is found. This is why no hand-rolled discriminator is needed: probed 2026-07-16, the 58 apt.llvm.org names and Ubuntu's 9308 main-component names across the 3 pockets overlap in EXACTLY 0 packages, so a merge can never cross upstreams, and a 15th Ubuntu package needs no routing config. Ubuntu MUST list all three pockets: the LTS release pocket is frozen at release day, so `suite=resolute` alone pins pre-security-patch versions that DO NOT INSTALL - `curl=8.18.0-1ubuntu2` fails because it hard-depends on its co-versioned `libcurl4t64` and apt will not drag that below its candidate (clean-room probe; see the [bootstrap.packages] header). components=main only: all 66 packages live in main, and adding `universe` would download a 19.6MB / 66741-package index per run for zero extra coverage (that index is what blew #251's 2-minute timeout, and it is why this was wrongly scoped as expensive). The datasource hardcodes Packages.gz, caches per component per run, and sends If-Modified-Since, so 66 deps cost one conditional GET per component on a warm run.

Parse the gcc-latest version out of the jwakely index hrefs (the html datasource yields full URLs as version candidates; the rolling gcc-latest.deb link has no version and is filtered out). timestamp-optional fixes a real bug (#160 T12.5): the html datasource emits NO releaseTimestamp, and the default minimumReleaseAge behavior holds timestamp-less updates FOREVER.

pixi: strip the upstream v prefix. prefix-dev/pixi tags releases vX.Y.Z, but mise's registry serves unprefixed versions only (zero v-prefixed pixi versions in `mise ls-remote pixi`, measured 2026-08-05) — without this rule Renovate writes pixi = "v0.76.1" into shared.toml, mise can never resolve it, and the all-deps PR goes red (PR #455, two consecutive failures).

customManagers.description: hk pkl schema pin (amends + import package:// URLs) — kept in lockstep with hk releases across hk.pkl, hk-common.pkl, hk-image.pkl. No native/preset manager covers a pkl amends URL. The version appears TWICE per URL (release tag `download/v<X>/` AND package `hk@<X>`); both matchStrings are required so a bump rewrites both — a single-occurrence match produces the 404 URL `v<new>/hk@<old>.zip` (fixed #248).
chezmoi minimum-version file. No native/preset manager covers .chezmoiversion.
clang-p2996 pinned git SHA (tagless p2996 branch HEAD). git-refs datasource; no preset handles a git digest.

gcc-latest.deb dated URL pin. Upstream (kayari) publishes NO checksum/signature — the immutable dated filename is the reproducibility handle. Bumped via the custom.gcc-latest HTML datasource on the jwakely index; no native/preset manager covers a rolling .deb URL. The companion GCC_LATEST_DEB_SHA256 is NOT managed here (Renovate can't hash an artifact); the gcc-sha-repair.yml workflow recomputes + commits it on this bump (#249).

ubuntu base image digest pin in docker-bake.hcl + Dockerfile ARG. The native docker/dockerfile managers do not parse bake HCL, and the digest feeds the base content-hash, so keep both files in lockstep here.

mise installer version pin (curl https://mise.run honors MISE_VERSION). The pin must track a mise version that reads the committed mise-system.lock format — Renovate bumps it, and the CI lock-refresh job regenerates the lock in lockstep.

dive layer-analysis version pin. The upstream action is broken (bare Dockerfile with an empty ARG DOCKER_CLI_VERSION → 404), so image-analysis.yml installs the release tarball directly and the version lives in a workflow env var no native manager parses. Same github-releases shape as the MISE_VERSION pin; the curl URL re-adds the v prefix.

#251/#288: EVERY pinned apt package in mise-system.toml [bootstrap.packages] - the 52 LLVM entries from apt.llvm.org and the 14 Ubuntu-archive entries. Renovate's NATIVE mise manager cannot do this - its schema parses only `tools`/`tasks` and z.object silently strips [bootstrap.packages] - so this regex + the `deb` datasource is the only route. Proven end-to-end (2026-07-15 LLVM, 2026-07-16 Ubuntu): extract yields depName/currentValue/replaceString, lookup resolves with no warnings. #236 does NOT apply: bootstrap packages are not in mise.lock and a regex manager has no lockfile to regenerate. The value regex anchors on a LEADING DIGIT, which matches every deb version (incl. the `1:` epoch forms `1:22.1.8~++...` and `1:1.3.dfsg+really1.3.1-1ubuntu3`) while never matching "latest" - a negative lookahead is NOT an option here, because Renovate compiles regexes with RE2, which has no lookaround. Routing to the right upstream is NOT done here: the `apt-ubuntu-pockets` packageRules entry below hands every deb dep all four registryUrls and lets registryStrategy='merge' resolve each by where it is found.
